SpecCoverageClaim.description: One claim inside the coverage matrix: a criterion of one Ticket claiming the story of the row it sits in.

ticket_id.description: The Ticket whose criterion claims the story.

ticket_number.description: The number the Ticket's Project minted for it; rendered with the Project's code, for example `CORE-T17`.

SpecCoverageMatrixRow.description: One row of the coverage matrix: a User Story of the reported version and every claim a Ticket's criterion makes on it, in claim order. An empty claim list is the row's coverage gap.

claims.description: The claims Tickets' criteria make on this story, in claim order; empty while the story stays uncovered (DR-PS-14).

story.description: The story, as its full identity `CORE-S3-US6`.

description: Response payload for the `spec.coverage.matrix` query: the coverage matrix of one Spec version, one row per User Story in scope order, completing the planning diagnostics (DR-PS-18).

stories.description: One row per User Story the version claims, in scope order.

version.description: The content version the matrix reports.

title: SpecCoverageMatrixResponse
